definition_en: Short-acting insulin secretagogues that close pancreatic beta-cell ATP-sensitive potassium channels, taken with meals.
scope_note_en: Project class (2026-10-25). Members are defined by their ATC level-5 codes, the label by the FDA Established Pharmacologic Class.
